body.statement: In the binary continuous-outcome construction of Supplement S8.2, the partition basis vector \(V^\ell\) is dense in the observed tangent-space orthocomplement as the equal-width partition resolution tends to infinity, on subsequences for which the displayed denominators and Gram inverses are well defined.

source.locator: Supplement S8.2, continuous-outcome case, paragraph following the basis construction
source.verbatim_statement: then \(V^{K}\) is a basis system of functions dense in \(\Lambda^{\bot}\) as \(K\to\infty\)

attestation.note: Transcribed from arXiv:2405.09080v4, Supplement S8.2, continuous-Y case.
